### OpenApiPreviewOperation

```ts
type OpenApiPreviewOperation =
  | OpenApiOperation
  | {
      status: "unsupported";
      name: string;
      method: string;
      path: string;
      reason: OpenApiRefusalCode;
    };
```

An operation's supported call shape or bounded unsupported reason.
